caption: The video captures a lone, leafless tree standing in silhouette at the center of a thin dark horizon line. Above it stretches a starry night sky, graded from deep blue at the top to a pale glow along the horizon. Below lies a calm, mirror-like water surface reflecting the bare tree almost perfectly. Throughout the excerpt the tree, its reflection, the horizon and the sky gradient hold their positions and shapes without shifting or deforming. The only visible motion is the quiet drift of a few tiny bright specks scattered across the water and the lower sky. These small points of light appear, fade and slowly change position from frame to frame, lingering near the right edge and just below the reflection. The upper star field shows no measurable movement, leaving the composition symmetrical and still apart from the drifting specks.
